title: Nobody created this the way you think.
caption:
A Seedance 2.5 AI clip of a fantasy battle spread online as what many took for real game footage.

The video shows a dwarf ranger fighting a creature, complete with health bars and a full game interface.
Account IsThisA3DModel flagged it on X, writing it is AI-generated video, not AAA gameplay.
The debunking post reached 225,000 views and more than 8,500 likes.

Video: IsThisA3DModel on X
#AIVideo #FakeGameplay #GenerativeAI
